questions.q: According to this lesson, what role should a certification generally play relative to hands-on governance experience?
options: It supports and puts a credential behind real experience — it isn't a substitute for having built something hands-on
It should always be pursued before any hands-on project work
It replaces the need for a capstone project entirely
Certifications have no value at all in a governance career
questions.explain: This lesson, consistent with every other certifications lesson in this catalog, frames a certification as most useful after real project experience exists, not as a substitute for it.

questions.q: Which certification does this lesson identify as most directly aligned with the DMBOK framework and DAMA Wheel taught earlier in this path?
options: CDMP, the Certified Data Management Professional credential from DAMA International
CIPP, from IAPP
CDPSE, from ISACA
A Microsoft Purview-specific exam
questions.explain: DAMA International's CDMP is described as the credential most directly aligned with the DMBOK and DAMA Wheel vocabulary this catalog's foundations course taught.

questions.q: Which two IAPP credentials does this lesson name for privacy-focused governance work, and what does each generally cover?
options: CIPP (privacy law and practice by jurisdiction) and CIPM (operationally managing a privacy program)
CDMP and CDPSE, both issued by IAPP
CGEIT and CRISC, both focused on IT auditing
A single combined exam called CIPP-CIPM
questions.explain: The lesson names CIPP (privacy law/practice in a jurisdiction) and CIPM (operational privacy program management) as IAPP's relevant credentials, alongside ISACA's CDPSE for a more technical angle.

questions.q: Why does this lesson avoid naming specific current exam codes for vendor platforms like Microsoft, Collibra, Informatica, and Alation?
options: Because vendor exam catalogs change frequently, and a stale exam name is worse than no claim at all
Because those vendors don't actually offer any certifications
Because vendor certifications are illegal to mention by name
Because this lesson forgot to research them
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly hedges on vendor-specific exam codes because certification programs are renamed or retired over time, and names the general existence of these programs without claiming unverifiable specifics.

questions.q: According to this lesson, when is pursuing a certification a weaker choice?
options: When it's pursued instead of hands-on project work, especially early in a career
Whenever a certification is backed by a real capstone project
Any time a certification is vendor-neutral rather than vendor-specific
Only when the certification is issued by DAMA International
questions.explain: The lesson states a certification is a weaker choice when pursued in place of hands-on project work, since hiring managers generally weigh a real project more heavily than a standalone certification.
